Cash and short-term investments significantly decreased (84.5 to 37.5), which might suggest tighter liquidity, but it's also possible the company deployed that cash into other areas.

The substantial increase in net income and improved profit margins outweigh the decline in revenue and reduced cash position. The increase in long term debt is a point of concern, but the improved profitability provides some cushion.
